dataset_citation: Heart Failure Clinical Records [Dataset]. (2020). UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5Z89R.
collector_citation: Ahmad T, Munir A, Bhatti SH, Aftab M, Raza MA (2017). Survival analysis of heart failure patients: A case study. PLoS ONE 12(7): e0181001. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0181001.
source_changes: None: CSV extracted byte-for-byte from the UCI archive; only the local filename differs.
calculation_scope: Only time (follow-up days) and DEATH_EVENT (1 observed death, 0 right censor); descriptive KM/risk counts only. No clinical predictor, tuning or causal/treatment inference.
